constants.step_index: step 0 is the initial state; step t is after t updates
constants.update: synchronous (all flies from the same phases)
constants.snapshot_rule: per snapshot cell, the seed whose final r is closest to the cell median (ties to the lower seed)
constants.control_note: the no-coupling control ignores the graph, so for one count and seed it is identical at every radius
constants.neighbor_rule: distance < radius, positions fixed, uniform random in the unit square
